# Trevra

> Trevra is the open-source operating system and control plane for agent-run go-to-market. Give Claude Code or Codex a revenue outcome, compose modular skills, record every run with evidence, and gate consequential work behind workspace policy.

## Primary resources
- https://usetrevra.com/
- https://usetrevra.com/catalog/modules.json
- https://usetrevra.com/privacy
- https://usetrevra.com/terms
- https://usetrevra.com/agents.md

## Product boundaries
Models may interpret commercial context. Deterministic software controls permissions, state transitions, approvals, amounts, payload hashing, and external execution. Installing a module does not grant it external-write permission.
